subject: SkyForge: phasewise multi-squad onboarding and quota uplift
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@skyforge.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion request — onboarding 3 new product squads + throughput uplift

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and cost controls. We're planning to accelerate two upcoming product launches and would like to expand our Redwood footprint before EOY. High-level ask: provision 3 additional API keys (one per new product squad), and provision for an expected sustained throughput increase of ~2x (peak concurrency during launches).

Questions:
- Can we get an estimate for committed capacity pricing for that uplift?
- Any recommended rollout cadence or playbook for minimizing noisy neighbor risk across teams?
- Will a simple contract addendum cover this, or do you need a new SOW?

I attached a short requirements doc with anticipated traffic windows. Would love to get a quick intake call this week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Porter
Head of Integrations, SkyForge, Inc.
attachments: growth_requirements.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@skyforge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — onboarding 3 new product squads + throughput uplift

Alex —

Appreciate the context and the doc. Short answer: yes, we can support the three additional squads and the ~2x sustained throughput, but we'll want to stage the rollout to validate cache locality and burst profiles. Proposed next steps:

1) Intake call (30 min) this week to map teams, expected go-live windows, and short-lived spikes vs sustained load.
2) Provision three distinct API key namespaces (one per squad) and a shared namespace for any cross-squad services.
3) Canary each squad for 48 hours at low concurrency, then increase to target throughput.
4) Draft a one-page amendment to the existing contract covering committed capacity, billing uplift, and an SLA addendum.

I've attached our provisioning checklist and a tentative rollout cadence. Monica will take point on pricing and the amendment; Karthik will run capacity checks and outline any Dedicated-pool recommendations if we hit burst limits.

We can do Thursday 10/30 at 10:00 PT — does that work?

Cheers,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Growth — Redwood Inference
attachments: provisioning_checklist.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T12:09:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion request — onboarding 3 new product squads + throughput uplift

Team — looping you both in after Alex's note. TL;DR: SkyForge wants 3 per-squad keys + ~2x sustained throughput. They're targeting a phased rollout across Nov–Dec.

Monica: can you put together a pricing uplift scenario (monthly committed token bands + overage rates) and a recommended concession on add-on commits? Think they want a straightforward addendum rather than a full SOW.

Karthik: can you validate current capacity for their tenant, and whether we should recommend Dedicated pods for initial launches or if auto-scaling on Hosted will be sufficient. Also call out any lead time for issuing additional keys and IP allowlists.

Keep it pragmatic — Alex asked for a 30-min intake Thurs 10/30 at 10 PT. I'll be on the call.

- Grace
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Expansion request — onboarding 3 new product squads + throughput uplift

Grace / Karthik —

Quick proposal based on their growth_requirements.pdf and our historical telemetry:

- Pricing path: addendum with committed monthly tokens bumped 2x for the three new squads (combined uplift). Recommend 6-month ramp with a 3-month minimum commit to secure capacity.
- Commercial concession: 10% on the incremental committed band for the first 6 months (introductory uplift discount).
- SLAs: standard enterprise SLA applies; propose adding a targeted latency SLO for priority traffic under the dedicated namespace.

Operational notes:
- We can issue three separate API key namespaces within 24 hours after DocuSign on the addendum.
- If they require guaranteed concurrency windows (e.g., Black Friday style), recommend reserving Dedicated pool slices — lead time ~10 business days.

Drafted a short amendment (attached) that we can send to Alex after the intake call. I'll link the HubSpot deal and prep the pricing worksheet.

Attachments: amendment_draft.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DF-1287

—Monica
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@skyforge.ai>, SkyForge Procurement <contracts@skyforge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — onboarding 3 new product squads + throughput uplift

Alex —

Great to sync earlier. Confirming next steps and timeline:

1) We will prepare the addendum reflecting the uplifted committed band, the 10% introductory concession on the incremental portion, and the per-namespace key issuance.
2) DocuSign link for the addendum is here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?powerFormId=abcd-1234-efgh-5678
3) Once countersigned, we will:
   - Issue three API key namespaces within 24 hours.
   - Kick off a 48-hour canary for Squad A (you cited the payments team), then unblock Squads B and C in sequence across a 72-hour window each.
   - If you want reserved Dedicated slices for guaranteed concurrency, we can provision those; note the ~10 business day lead time to reserve capacity.

Attachments for your records: deployment_matrix.xlsx (mapping teams to namespaces and rollout windows), amendment_draft.docx.

Would you like us to route the DocuSign to your procurement alias or to you directly? If procurement wants to preview redlines, Monica can share a redline-ready doc.

Looking forward — happy to jump back on a call if you want to tighten timing.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Growth — Redwood Inference
attachments: deployment_matrix.xlsx, amendment_draft.docx
